body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> SOYO presented its 12-inch notebook pc 'SY-12-SH250' at 2009 CES, which is equipped with Intel Core 2 Duo T5800 processor and 160GB HDD. It is expected to be available in next week, and no words on pricing yet.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
